findings.statement: The synthetic CF4 algebra is the valuable salvage core, including the corrected STF signs and projector-based eigenspace drift, but it needs unit-covariant normalized rank/eigengap decisions, an ill-conditioning or registered-rank-reduction path, and common-response provenance before its rank/weak-ID outputs are coherent.
assumptions_used: Metric signature is irrelevant to this observer-side Euclidean velocity design; Galactic Cartesian coordinates are right-handed.
The radial model is v_r=m+B.n+r n_i S_ij n_j with S trace-free, positive v_r receding, r in Mpc, velocity in km/s.
All evaluated numerical fixtures remain synthetic.
reproduction: Analytic sign check: with Szz=-Sxx-Syy, n^T S n=Sxx(x^2-z^2)+Syy(y^2-z^2)+2Sxyxy+2Sxzxz+2Syzyz; the 1417804b design matches this.
Rescale shear coordinates and distance units while preserving the physical response; current absolute eigengap_floor and mixed-coordinate matrix-rank paths are not contractually invariant.
Supply an extremely ill-conditioned positive-definite covariance; eigenvalue>0 alone can pass before direct inversion, so a registered conditioning/rank-reduction decision is required.
unresolved: The exact registered parameter normalizer/coordinate map for future observed local/global response remains unavailable and must not be invented in PR-291.

findings.statement: BLOCKING: the current scanner, and the G61 historical scanner proposed for salvage, suppress any matched forbidden claim when any broad marker such as 'not ', 'no ', or 'without' occurs on an unrelated nearby line. scan_text calls _is_guardrail_context before recording an issue; that helper concatenates two preceding lines, the match line, and one following line and returns true on a substring marker. The same helper is also applied independently to both source-observable window lines and every touched multiline-CF4 line. On Markdown table rows it scans the whole row before the existing exact forbidden-column helper runs. Therefore unrelated caveat prose or another table cell can hide a positive production claim.
assumptions_used: The audit's requested 'matched sentence/structured Markdown context' ceiling governs the salvage repair.
A forbidden claim and a distinct caveat sentence or Markdown cell are semantically independent even when source-adjacent.
The mutable candidate has no acceptance standing and was not evaluated.

tests/contracts/test_claim_language_lint.py:140-151 proves the YAML exemption is intended not to leak
reproduction: Static current-path proof: for text 'No observed bytes were read.\nBianchi family identified in this artifact.', geometry_detected matches line 2; scan_text calls _is_guardrail_context; its [index-2,index+2) window contains 'no '; the function returns true and scan_text continues without an issue.
Static same-line proof: 'No observed bytes were read. Bianchi family identified in this artifact.' is likewise suppressed even though the negative sentence and positive claim sentence are distinct.

Static G61 proof after CF4 salvage: 'The observed lane is not authorized.\nPhysical cosmic vorticity is supported by the 0.0089 curl diagnostic.' reaches the historical legacy_curl_physics_promotion match, then the same nearby-window helper suppresses it.

Static table proof: a positive match in an Allowed cell is suppressed if a different cell in the same row contains 'do not', because the whole-row marker return occurs before _match_is_in_forbidden_markdown_column.

findings.statement: Smallest repair and discriminating test contract: change _is_guardrail_context so ordinary prose exemption is evaluated only on the sentence containing the regex match, while retaining exact YAML guardrail-section ancestry and the existing matched forbidden-Markdown-column helper. Add only a tiny exact structured-list check for list items governed by an explicit 'Forbidden examples:' label so the existing negative-example fixture remains valid; do not retain the generic nearby-line window. Pass match/span information from scan_text, _scan_source_observable_windows, and _scan_multiline_legacy_curl_windows so all three paths share the same scope. Remove the whole-row table marker shortcut and let the existing cell-aware helper decide. For multiline CF4 matches, evaluate the folded match-bearing sentence once, not every touched source line. Positive regressions must flag a geometry or CF4 promotion despite unrelated 'not', 'no', and 'without' sentences both before and after it, including one same-source-line two-sentence case and an Allowed table cell whose neighboring cell says 'do not'. Negative controls must allow true same-sentence downclaims, the exact YAML keys, explicit Forbidden-examples list items, forbidden-reading cells, proper fences, distinct list items, quote-depth changes, and lazy blockquote downclaims. Preserve current determiner/verb-inflection geometry cases plus every G57-G61 reordered/wrapped/blockquote positive case.
assumptions_used: Sentence punctuation plus the scanner's existing Markdown container boundaries is sufficient for this bounded repair.
An exact structured-list label is narrower than generic marker proximity and does not constitute a new scanner framework.
counterevidence_refs: A sentence-only change without the exact Forbidden-examples list container would regress tests/contracts/test_claim_language_lint.py:114-124.
A main scan_text-only change would leave _scan_source_observable_windows and the G59-G61 multiline helper with the same broad suppression defect.
reproduction: Required focused command after implementation: python -m pytest tests/contracts/test_claim_language_lint.py tests/contracts/test_semantic_guards.py -q
Required direct positive fixtures: unrelated 'not', 'no', and 'without' in preceding/following sentences must each yield exactly the intended rule_id.
Required direct negative fixtures: same-sentence 'is not supported', 'does not establish', and 'does not rescue' must yield no issues.
Required CommonMark fixture set: retain G59 ordinary wraps/list boundaries, G60 repeated and nested blockquotes/quoted fences, and G61 lazy blockquote plus quote-container fence transitions.
Required CLI smoke after focused tests: python scripts/check_claim_language.py docs --dry-run --format json; inspect nonzero output rather than weakening rules if existing production text is exposed.

Kill switch: stop on any regression in YAML exact-section scoping, forbidden-column cell scoping, fences, list boundaries, or negative downclaims.
